newsitem.title: FINLAND: VALTAMERI SEES 96/97 PROFIT UP ON 95/96.
newsitem.headline: VALTAMERI SEES 96/97 PROFIT UP ON 95/96.

text.p: Finnish trading house Valtameri Oy said on Monday it expected its 1996/97 profit before appropriations and taxes to improve on the previous financial year to April 30.
"The result for the financial year before appropriations and taxes is expected to improve from the previous financial year," it said in a statement. The previous year profit was eight million markka.

Valtameri, which is listed on the Helsinki OTC list, said earlier its May-October operating profit fell to 5.6 million markka from 6.8 million, and its profit before extraordinary items and taxes eased to 5.8 million markka from 7.1 million.
